standard-dialogue-after-sins-of-the-fath.npc: You! You're the one that lost me my tithes. Get out before I have you killed!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.npc: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!

standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.npc: Then be on your way. I have a meeting with Lord Vitur soon and I don't need any distractions.

if-the-player-is-disguised-and-has-not-y.npc: Tell me, [player vampyre name], what blood tastes the best?
You misunderstand me, I mean what kind of human?
What? I mean, yes. But what else?

if-the-player-is-disguised-and-has-not-y.player: I don't know... What's the actual answer?

if-the-player-is-disguised-and-has-not-y.npc: Love. Blood tastes best when it comes from one who loves.
Too many around here treat their tithes with discontentment. When they do, they miss out on the full potential blood has to offer.
Treat your tithes with respect instead. They will come to love you, and their blood becomes so much better as a result.

if-the-player-is-disguised-and-has-not-y.player: I see. I'll keep that in mind.
